extraction.Name: Luther Wright
extraction.Refused/Protested: I took it to the farmer at Okreek and told him that I did not want it and he said that he could not help it as it had been issued to me and it would be necessary for me to keep it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The sale was satisfactory so far as that goes as I had to do something with the land on account of the patent having been issued and taxes were high
extraction.Occupation/Income: I farm some and work at odd jobs
extraction.NOTES: Received patent by mail in 1920; did not sign a receipt for it; got $5600.00 and a Buick roadster worth $1000.00 for the land; eight dependents; poor health and nearly blind; patent given without his asking for it; notarized June 6, 1929 by Zas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
